   Create hello.txt

   Context

   The user wants a file hello.txt containing the word hi, planned in at most two steps. The working directory
   (.../scratchpad/plan-probe/runD) is not a git repo, so no worktree or commit is involved.

   Steps

   1. Write hello.txt in the working directory with the content hi (single line, trailing newline).
   2. Verify with cat hello.txt, expecting the output hi.
